div.div:
Scenario:
A university needs to create a database to keep track of its academic information.
The university has several departments. Each department has a unique Department_ID, a Department_Name, and a Building_Location.
Each department offers several courses. A course cannot exist without a department. Each course has a Course_Code (unique only inside its department), a Course_Title, and the number of Units.
The university also has professors. Each professor has a unique Employee_ID, a Professor_Name, and a Rank. Each professor is assigned to one department, but a department can have many professors.
